name: GLM 5.3 FlashX
description: GLM-5.3-FlashX is the high-speed serving option for Z.ai’s native multimodal coding model, featuring 320B total parameters, 18B activated parameters, and a 1M-token context window. Its efficient hybrid attention architecture supports visual coding, tool use, and end-to-end professional workflows across code, browsers, documents, and graphical interfaces.
